_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior trim repaint. Context prefix TRRP (TRim RePaint) — no collision with existing prefixes. TRIM is taken by SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT interior trim. Combined assess+prep+prime+finish in single spec (same mobilization). 8 trim component types all measured in LF. Second repaint spec in the system after SF_SIDING_WOOD_EXT_RP — reuses substrate_condition and substrate_state patterns from that sibling. QT3-QT5 range (QT2 excluded — trim is fine-finish substrate). Brush is primary application method; spray is conditional.

paintable_items.name: Exterior fascia board
paintable_items.notes: NEW exterior item. Horizontal board at eave/roofline. PCA P10 one-foot rule: <12" wide = 1 SF per 1 LF. Typically at high/extreme height tier.

paintable_items.name: Exterior rake board
paintable_items.notes: NEW exterior item. Diagonal trim following roofline at gable end. Spans multiple height tiers from ground to peak.

paintable_items.name: Exterior frieze board
paintable_items.notes: NEW exterior item. Horizontal board at top of wall below soffit. Existing surface_ref ext_trim_frieze in registry.

paintable_items.name: Exterior corner board
paintable_items.notes: NEW exterior item. Vertical board at building corners. Spans full wall height — may cross multiple height tiers. Existing surface_ref ext_trim_corner in registry.

paintable_items.name: Exterior band board
paintable_items.notes: NEW exterior item. Horizontal trim between floors (belt course). Typically at first_8_13ft height tier on 2-story homes.

paintable_items.name: Exterior window casing
paintable_items.notes: NEW exterior item. Distinct from interior ITM_TRIM_CASING_WINDOW. _EXT suffix required to avoid collision with interior casing item. Existing surface_ref ext_trim_window_casing in registry.

paintable_items.name: Exterior door casing
paintable_items.notes: NEW exterior item. Distinct from interior ITM_TRIM_CASING_DOOR. _EXT suffix required to avoid collision with interior casing item. Existing surface_ref ext_trim_door_casing in registry.

paintable_items.name: Exterior window sill
paintable_items.notes: NEW exterior item. Horizontal board at bottom of window opening. Highest rot-risk component (horizontal surface collects water). _EXT suffix for exterior context.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, WSRP. TRRP is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_TRRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_TRRP_ASSESS_CONDITION, TSK_TRRP_WASH_LOW_PRESSURE, TSK_TRRP_SCRAPE_LOOSE, TSK_TRRP_FEATHER_SAND, TSK_TRRP_SPOT_PRIME_BRUSH, TSK_TRRP_FULL_PRIME_BRUSH, TSK_TRRP_FINISH_BRUSH_1, TSK_TRRP_CAULK_REPLACE, TSK_TRRP_MASK_SIDING

expected_modules.notes: Condition assessment — DSD rating per component, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, MC testing, coating ID, rot probe. MANDATORY first module (repaint-specific). Fixed time 1.0-2.0 hrs. Results determine which subsequent modules and tasks activate.
Protection setup — ground cover, landscape, hardscape, light fixtures, roofline protection, siding masking (spray only), window/door masking.
Power wash trim at low pressure (500-1000 PSI). Careful at joints to prevent water intrusion. All substrate states. 24-48 hour dry time before coating.

Scraping and feather-edge sanding. Conditional on substrate state: SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT activates light-moderate scrape, SS_EXT_PEELING activates heavy scrape. Feather-edge sanding MANDATORY on all scraped areas (non-negotiable at all QT). RRP wrapper when pre-1978.
Chalk remediation. Conditional on SS_EXT_CHALKING. Cleaning hierarchy: rinse → mechanical sand → controlled pressure wash. Hand-rub test to verify removal. 24-48 hour drying. Re-test.

Caulk assessment and replacement at all trim-to-adjacent-surface joints. 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol. LF-based. Remove old failed caulk → clean joint → apply new caulk. Product varies by substrate material (PVC: NEVER silicone).

Primer application — spot prime or full prime depending on substrate state and bare area percentage. Primer type depends on substrate state AND substrate material. 5 primer paths: spot acrylic, chalk-binding, full acrylic stain-block, alkyd stain-block (tannin override), bonding (PVC). QT5 adds 2-coat primer.
Intercoat inspection and light sand. QT4: sand between finish coats (150-grit). QT5: sand between ALL coats including primer (180-220 grit). Skipped at QT3 (no interstage on standard trim).
First finish topcoat. Brush (primary) or spray. Sheen per QT: QT3=satin, QT4=semi-gloss, QT5=gloss.
Second finish topcoat. All tiers (QT3/QT4/QT5) receive 2 finish coats on trim.
Detail work and touch-up. Final inspection with raking light at QT5. Mark and repair defects. Touch-up transition lines at trim-to-siding junctions.
Protection teardown, site cleanup, tool cleaning, waste disposal. RRP adds lead-safe waste disposal when pre-1978.

quality_tier.notes: QT2 excluded — trim is fine-finish substrate. QT3 = satin, QT4 = semi-gloss, QT5 = gloss. QT5 adds 2-coat primer, interstage sanding between all coats, ultra-smooth brush technique.

application_method.notes: Brush is primary for trim (40 LF/hr baseline). Spray conditional on sufficient volume to justify masking overhead. brush_roll not applicable — trim is too narrow for roller. No backroll/rolloff on trim.

sheen.notes: Trim sheens only. QT3 = satin, QT4 = semi-gloss, QT5 = gloss. Flat and eggshell not used on exterior trim.

phase.notes: Combined spec. Assess module uses 'prep' phase. No 'apply' phase — uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: LF is primary UOM for all trim tasks. EA for protection items. FIXED for condition assessment and tool cleaning. No SF tasks — all trim <12" wide uses LF per PCA P10 one-foot rule.

substrate_state.notes: 4 repaint input states (all existing in controlled_enums.json). SS_EXT_WEATHERED excluded — weathered trim with no coating is bare wood (enters via rot repair as SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD). Stain states excluded. Output varies by sheen/QT.

trim_substrate_material.notes: Trim substrate material — modifier, not configuration dimension. Affects primer selection only. PVC triggers LRV >=55 or solar-reflective coating gate.

trim_component_height.notes: Per-component height tier. Maps to FAC_TRRP_HEIGHT modifier values.

trim_profile_complexity.notes: Per-component profile complexity. Maps to FAC_TRRP_COMPLEXITY modifier values.

product_role.notes: Primer and finish primary. Specialty for chalk-binding primer (unique product class) and edge sealer (engineered wood).

protection_level.notes: Full range needed — occupied repaint context. Siding masking upgrades to full_mask when freshly painted.

condition_scale.notes: Universal 3-level condition scale. Drives prep pool modifier: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x.

surface_ids.notes: Primary surfaces: ext_trim_frieze, ext_trim_corner, ext_trim_window_casing, ext_trim_door_casing exist in id_registry surface_ids. fascia, ext_trim_rake, ext_trim_band, ext_sill are proposed. Adjacent: siding_field, soffit_field, foundation_wall exist. window_glass_ext, door_slab_ext, masonry_wall are proposed surface IDs.

material_system_prefix.pattern: SYS_EXT_TRRP_{DESCRIPTION} for spec-specific systems. Reuse SYS_PRIMER_* and SYS_FINISH_ACRYLIC_EXTERIOR* from WSRP sibling where applicable.

SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_TANNIN — NC tannin-blocker. Reusable for trim repaint tannin scenarios on exposed wood.
SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_BONDING — NC bonding primer for factory-primed. Reusable for PVC trim bonding primer scenario.
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_STANDARD — NC QT3 finish. Same product class applies to trim repaint QT3.
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_PREMIUM — NC QT4 finish. Same product class applies to trim repaint QT4.
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_SUPERIOR — NC QT5 finish. Same product class applies to trim repaint QT5.
SYS_PRIMER_SPOT — proposed by WSRP sibling. Acrylic stain-blocking spot primer. REUSABLE for trim.
SYS_PRIMER_CHALK_BINDING — proposed by WSRP sibling. Chalk-binding penetrating primer. REUSABLE for trim.
SYS_PRIMER_STAIN_BLOCK_ACRYLIC — proposed by WSRP sibling. Full coverage acrylic stain-block. REUSABLE for trim.
SYS_PRIMER_STAIN_BLOCK_ALKYD — proposed by WSRP sibling. Alkyd tannin-blocking primer. REUSABLE for trim.
SYS_FINISH_ACRYLIC_EXTERIOR — proposed by WSRP sibling. Standard QT2/QT3 finish. REUSABLE for trim QT3.

proposed_systems.name: Acrylic Stain-Blocking Spot Primer
proposed_systems.notes: REUSE from WSRP sibling. Spot prime bare areas only. Sound paint with isolated bare spots, or failing paint with <30% bare.

proposed_systems.name: Chalk-Binding Penetrating Primer
proposed_systems.notes: REUSE from WSRP sibling. Low-viscosity, high-penetration resin for chalking surfaces.

proposed_systems.name: Bonding Primer for PVC Trim Substrate
proposed_systems.notes: NEW — trim-specific. Bonding primer formulated for non-porous PVC substrate. Standard acrylic and alkyd primers will not adhere. Consider reusing SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_BONDING if product is compatible.

proposed_systems.name: Acrylic Stain-Blocking Full Primer
proposed_systems.notes: REUSE from WSRP sibling. Full coverage when >30% bare or active peeling.

proposed_systems.name: Alkyd Stain-Blocking Primer (Tannin-Rich Wood)
proposed_systems.notes: REUSE from WSRP sibling. HARD OVERRIDE when tannin-rich wood (cedar/redwood) is exposed.

proposed_systems.name: 100% Acrylic Trim Paint (Satin/Semi-Gloss/Gloss)
proposed_systems.notes: Exterior acrylic trim paint. QT3 = satin (SW SuperPaint, BM Regal Select). QT4 = semi-gloss (SW Duration, BM Aura). QT5 = gloss (SW Emerald, BM Advance Exterior). Higher product grade at higher QT.

proposed_systems.name: Solar-Reflective Coating for PVC Trim (LRV <55)
proposed_systems.notes: NEW — conditional on PVC substrate when LRV <55. SW VinylSafe or BM Regal Select Exterior. Prevents thermal distortion on dark colors.

material_system_prefix.notes: 5 primer systems (spot, chalk-binding, bonding/PVC, full acrylic stain-block, alkyd tannin-block) + 2 finish systems (standard acrylic trim, IR-reflective for PVC). Primer selection driven by substrate_state AND substrate_material. Finish product is same class across all states — the coating on top is always 100% acrylic. QT drives product grade and sheen.

proposed_modifiers.applies_to: qt_scaled coating tasks only. QT3 = baseline. QT4 = greater care, tighter tolerances, semi-gloss. QT5 = maximum effort, gloss, near-zero defect tolerance.

proposed_modifiers.description: DSD-equivalent substrate condition prep labor multiplier
proposed_modifiers.applies_to: ALL prep tasks (scrape, sand, chalk remediation, caulk). Does NOT apply to coating (prime, finish) tasks — once prepped, surface is at baseline.
proposed_modifiers.notes: SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE (DSD-4) is HARD STOP — not a multiplier level. Triggers scope exclusion. Midpoint values from research ranges.

proposed_modifiers.applies_to: ALL tasks on the affected component (prep and coating). Per-component, not per-project. Fascia = high/extreme, ground-level casings = baseline.
proposed_modifiers.notes: Uses FAC_TRRP_HEIGHT, NOT FAC_EXT_ACCESS. Trim height tiers differ from siding access tiers because trim requires painter AT working height for brush work.

proposed_modifiers.description: Profile complexity modifier per component type
proposed_modifiers.applies_to: ALL tasks on the affected component (prep and coating). Per-component type. One building may have simple corner boards (1.0x) and elaborate window surrounds (1.60x).

proposed_modifiers.description: Lead-safe RRP modifier on prep tasks
proposed_modifiers.applies_to: ALL prep tasks involving paint disturbance (scraping, sanding, power washing with paint removal). Adds containment, wet scraping methods, HEPA vacuum, lead-safe disposal overhead.
proposed_modifiers.notes: Gate condition triggered by IN_BOOL_PRE_1978 = true. Trim is HIGH RISK for lead paint — historically received oil-based lead paint more frequently than field surfaces.

stacking_partition.formula: Effective Rate = Baseline Rate / (Pool_Modifiers x SHARED_Modifiers)
stacking_partition.max_theoretical_stack: SC_SEVERE (1.75) x RRP (2.00) x Extreme Height (2.20) x Elaborate (1.60) = 12.32x on prep tasks. EXCEEDS 4.0x flag threshold. Recommend T&M for extreme combinations.
stacking_partition.notes: PREP pool applies to prep tasks only. COATING pool applies to coating tasks only. SHARED applies to all tasks. Stacking is multiplicative within and across pools.

proposed_configurations.description: Spot prime (bare areas only) + 2 finish coats
proposed_configurations.notes: Standard repaint on sound paint. Spot prime bare/thin areas only. Full prime not needed if adhesion passes.

proposed_configurations.description: Spot prime + 2 finish coats with interstage sand between finish coats
proposed_configurations.notes: Premium trim repaint. Interstage sanding between finish coats.

proposed_configurations.description: 2-coat spot prime + interstage sand + 2 finish coats with interstage sand between all coats
proposed_configurations.notes: Superior trim repaint. 2-coat primer on bare areas + interstage between all coats. 4 total coating passes.
Chalk-binding primer mandatory full coverage. QT5 adds second primer coat and interstage between all.
Failing paint with <30% bare. Spot prime bare areas after scrape. Full prime if >30% bare (switches to ROUND_TRRP_FAILING_HEAVY).
Full prime when >30% bare or active peeling. SOP determines threshold at assessment. QT5 adds 2-coat primer.

proposed_profiles.description: Spot primer coverage on bare trim areas — 300-400 SF/gal (based on affected LF, not total trim LF).
Chalk-binding primer coverage on trim — 250-350 SF/gal. Low viscosity, high penetration absorbs more product.
Full coverage primer on scraped trim — 300-400 SF/gal on prepared surface.
Bonding primer on PVC trim — 350-450 SF/gal. Non-porous substrate, less absorption.
Finish coat coverage on primed/repaint trim — 350-400 SF/gal. Higher than siding RP due to smoother surface profile.

cross_spec_coordination.notes: Trim repaint is independent scope. Siding masking during trim spray is THIS spec's responsibility. Window/door masking during casing painting is THIS spec's responsibility. RRP gate condition is project-level (would affect all repaint specs on same project) but handled within each spec's prep module. Scaffold/lift is shared resource allocated at project level.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup → prep → prime → apply → interstage → finish → cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_TRRP_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: All ITM_ IDs MUST be used exactly as specified in this resolution's paintable_items
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums
RULE 12 (REPAINT-SPECIFIC): FAC_TRRP_CONDITION applies to prep tasks ONLY, NOT to prime/finish tasks. Coating rates are independent of previous condition.
RULE 13 (REPAINT-SPECIFIC): FAC_TRRP_CONDITION, FAC_TRRP_RRP, FAC_TRRP_HEIGHT, FAC_TRRP_COMPLEXITY stack MULTIPLICATIVELY. Effective Rate = Baseline / (Pool_Modifiers x SHARED_Modifiers).
RULE 14 (REPAINT-SPECIFIC): SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE (DSD-4) is a HARD STOP. Do NOT include in production rate tables. Triggers scope exclusion.
RULE 15 (REPAINT-SPECIFIC): FAC_TRRP_RRP is a gate condition modifier. Applies when IN_BOOL_PRE_1978 = true. Affects ALL prep tasks involving paint disturbance.
RULE 16 (TRIM-SPECIFIC): Each trim component is processed independently via its own PS key. Height and complexity modifiers are PER-COMPONENT, not per-project.
RULE 17 (TRIM-SPECIFIC): Feather-edge sanding (TSK_TRRP_FEATHER_SAND) is MANDATORY whenever scraping occurs — non-negotiable at all quality tiers.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Pre-1978 Building Flag Input (BOOL)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.FLAG.PRE_1978. Shared with WSRP.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Window Glass Masking Count
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — count of windows requiring masking when painting adjacent trim casings.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Window Glass Masking Count Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_PROTECT_EA.GLASS_WINDOW.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door Masking Count
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — count of doors requiring masking when painting adjacent trim casings.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door Masking Count Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_PROTECT_EA.GLASS_DOOR.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Siding Adjacent Masking Area
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — siding area requiring masking when trim is sprayed. Conditional on application_method = spray.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Siding Adjacent Masking Area Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_PROTECT_SF.SIDING_ADJACENT.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Sound substrate condition (DSD-0)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW ENUM TYPE — shared with SF_SIDING_WOOD_EXT_RP. MPI DSD mapped to SC_ prefix. 5 values: SC_SOUND through SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior fascia board surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW surface vocabulary entry. Horizontal board at eave/roofline.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior rake board surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW surface vocabulary entry. Diagonal trim at gable end.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior band board surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW surface vocabulary entry. Horizontal trim between floors.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior window sill surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW surface vocabulary entry. Horizontal board at bottom of window opening.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior window glass (adjacent/protection target)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW surface vocabulary entry for adjacency declarations.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door face (adjacent/protection target)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW surface vocabulary entry for adjacency declarations.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Masonry wall (adjacent surface)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW surface vocabulary entry for adjacency declarations. Brick/stone adjacent to trim.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Siding Masking Zone (spray trim)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — masking siding when spraying trim. Conditional on application_method = spray.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Window Glass Masking Zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — masking window glass when painting adjacent casings.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Door Masking Zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — masking door face when painting adjacent casings.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Ground Cover Zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — ground-level protection from scraping debris, wash water, and paint drips. Upgrades for RRP containment.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Roofline Protection Zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — protecting roofing material when painting fascia/rake boards.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Trim Repaint Quality Tier Modifier
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — QT modifier for trim repaint. QT3=1.00, QT4=1.25, QT5=1.50. Coating tasks only.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Trim Repaint DSD Condition Modifier
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — DSD prep labor multiplier. SC_SOUND=1.00, SC_SLIGHT=1.15, SC_MODERATE=1.375, SC_SEVERE=1.75. Prep tasks only.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Trim-Specific Height Modifier
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — trim-specific height tiers (1.00/1.30/1.60/1.90/2.20). Per-component, not per-project. Different from FAC_EXT_ACCESS.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Trim Profile Complexity Modifier
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — profile complexity (1.00/1.15/1.30/1.60). Per-component type. Affects all tasks on that component.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Trim Repaint Lead-Safe RRP Modifier
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — RRP gate modifier. none=1.00, tested_positive=2.00. Prep tasks involving paint disturbance only.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Bonding Primer for PVC Trim
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — trim-specific bonding primer for non-porous PVC substrate. SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_BONDING is for factory-primed wood, not PVC.

registry_additions_proposed.name: 100% Acrylic Trim Paint (Satin/Semi-Gloss/Gloss)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — exterior trim finish paint. Covers all sheens and QT3-QT5 product grades. Distinct from siding finish (different product grades, different sheen range, different coverage rates).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Solar-Reflective Coating for PVC Trim
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — PVC-specific finish for dark colors (LRV <55). Prevents thermal distortion. SW VinylSafe, BM Regal Select Exterior.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Trim Repaint Spot Primer Coverage
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Spot primer coverage on bare trim areas — 300-400 SF/gal.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Trim Repaint Chalk-Binding Primer Coverage
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Chalk-binding primer on trim — 250-350 SF/gal.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Trim Repaint Full Primer Coverage
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Full coverage primer on scraped trim — 300-400 SF/gal.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Trim Repaint Bonding Primer Coverage (PVC)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Bonding primer on PVC trim — 350-450 SF/gal.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Trim Repaint Finish Coat Coverage
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Finish coat on primed/repaint trim — 350-400 SF/gal.
